item.title: Shawnee boys go 1-1 in regional, headed to area tournament
item.description: TULSA – The Shawnee Wolves faced one of the state’s premier teams in Class 5A in Tulsa Booker T. Washington and suffered a 99-55 defeat at the hands of the Hornets on Saturday in a regional final contest.

item.title: Insurance Careers Month: Exploring public service at OID
item.description: When Oklahomans file claims, buy coverage or seek help navigating complex policies, someone behind the scenes is working to ensure that process is fair and reliable. That work doesn't happen by accident.

item.title: Accreditation collaboration brings NOC, SSC leaders together
item.description: Administrators and staff from Northern Oklahoma College in Tonkawa, Enid and Stillwater visited with Seminole State College leaders on Feb. 26 to discuss Higher Learning Commission accreditation efforts.

item.title: AAA: Tips to stay safe when winter weather strikes while driving
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY – Spring and summer are a time to keep an eye to the sky and stay weather-aware. As many people in this part of the country are aware, strong thunderstorms and even tornadoes can strike quickly and fiercely.

item.title: OBU students win gold and silver at 2026 American Advertising Awards
item.description: Oklahoma Baptist University seniors McKenzie Stewart and Kyndall Hicks earned top honors at the 2026 American Advertising Awards, presented by the American Advertising Federation, on Saturday, Feb. 21, 2026, at the Omni Hotel in downtown Oklahoma City.

item.title: Emergency Drought Committee approves assistance program
item.description: Oklahoma City - The Emergency Drought Committee met on Tuesday, February 24, 2026, and voted to approve a new program aimed to provide emergency drought assistance to Oklahoma producers. The application period opens March 9 and runs through June 30, 2026.

item.title: Shawnee announces opening of Pre-K and freshman enrollment for new students
item.description: Shawnee Public Schools is excited to announce that enrollment is now open for new-to-the-district students entering Pre-Kindergarten at Shawnee Early Childhood Center and for incoming freshmen at Shawnee High School for the upcoming school year.

item.title: Redskins upend Savages in fourth meeting of the season
item.description: McLOUD - A high-energy first quarter was proof of the rivalry between Tecumseh and McLoud as they played for the second time in a week and the fourth time this season.

item.title: CareerTech launches Oklahoma Career Readiness Diploma
item.description: The approximately 279,000 Oklahomans without high school diplomas now have another way to earn the credential that will help them advance in careers or further their education. Oklahoma CareerTech’s Adult Education and Family Literacy division has launched the Oklahoma Career Readiness Diploma, which allows participants to count scores from previous assessments, like the GED and HiSET tests, along with any credits they earned in high school.
